note: L1 domain knowledge: the machine primitives the grounded clauses' receipts depend on, each self-defined (what it is, who owns it, what it writes). An agent may rely only on primitives defined here, never on undocumented organizational knowledge.

environments.repository-machine: agent-driven repository machine of the ed3c/noodles class: issue-contract ceremony, trusted verify, mechanical landing
environments.host-scheduler: the host's job launcher and its jobs (second environment class; carries the C11 receipt)

trusted-verifier.what: CI job that runs the default branch's tests against the candidate as data; its success event is the only trigger for landing
trusted-verifier.writes: check conclusions on the candidate head

landing-authority.what: workflow that performs the exact-head merge and issue closure on verify success; agents and monitors never merge
landing-authority.writes: merge commits, issue state, anchor comments

landing-train.what: mechanical rebaser that serves the oldest open landable head that is behind the default branch; textual replay only, conflicts fail back to the owner

state-marker.what: issue-body contract field over {ready, in_progress, awaiting_land, landed, blocked}; awaiting_land means mechanically landable, nothing softer
state-marker.owner: ceremony (agents flip it only at defined transitions)

quarantine-blocker.what: receipt naming an observed death pattern and explicit unblock conditions, parked on the failing target so the fleet routes around it
quarantine-blocker.owner: the supervising role that observed the repeats

salvage-ref.what: durable ref the bytes are pushed to before any reset or delete, so no live work can be destroyed by teardown

map-revision-atom.what: admission-data catch-up change that lets in-flight candidates satisfy a newly landed gate; the gate itself never rolls back and candidates never widen the surface they are judged against

completion-notification.what: the harness-owned signal that a dispatched background run has ended; the only death certificate such a run has

exit-residue.what: a launcher's displayed last-exit status; describes one past run of the job and may survive a later successful run
